title: LLM Serving - vLLM
description: Golden signals, SLOs, scheduler state and unit economics for vLLM.

panels.title: TTFT p95
panels.description: Time to first token. SLO: 99% under 2.5s.

panels.title: Inter-token latency p95
panels.description: Gap between streamed tokens. 50 ms = 20 tokens/s per user.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="vllm", namespace=~"$namespace", handler=~"/v1/.*", status="5xx"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="vllm", namespace=~"$namespace", handler=~"/v1/.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

1 - ((sum(increase(http_requests_total{job="vllm", namespace=~"$namespace", handler=~"/v1/.*", status="5xx"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(increase(http_requests_total{job="vllm", namespace=~"$namespace", handler=~"/v1/.*"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Availability burn (1h)
panels.description: 1 = spending the budget exactly over 30 days. 14.4 pages.

targets.expr: ((sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="vllm", namespace=~"$namespace", handler=~"/v1/.*", status="5xx"}[1h])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="vllm", namespace=~"$namespace", handler=~"/v1/.*"}[1h]))) / 0.005

panels.title: Time to first token
panels.description: Dominated by queueing + prefill. Grows with prompt length and load.

panels.title: Inter-token latency
panels.description: Decode speed per user. Grows with batch size (concurrency).

panels.title: Where time goes (p95)
panels.description: Queue time rising first means you need more replicas, not a faster GPU.

panels.title: Finished requests by reason
panels.description: stop = natural end, length = hit max_tokens, abort = client went away.

panels.title: HTTP responses by status
panels.description: A stream that fails after headers are sent still counts as 2xx.

panels.title: Running vs waiting requests
panels.description: Waiting > 0 for long = batch is full (max-num-seqs or KV cache).

panels.title: Preemptions / s
panels.description: Sequences evicted from KV cache and recomputed later. Should be ~0.

panels.title: Prefix cache hit ratio
panels.description: Shared system prompts make prefill nearly free when this is high.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total{namespace=~"$namespace", model_name=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pod) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total{namespace=~"$namespace", model_name=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: In-flight requests per replica
panels.description: The KEDA scaling signal. Compare with targetInFlightPerReplica.

panels.title: GPU utilisation of serving pods
panels.description: Near 100% at any batch size: a poor autoscaling signal, a fine saturation hint.

panels.title: Cost per 1M generated tokens
panels.description: Physical GPUs x $/hour / generated tokens per hour, at the current load. Set the price in the GPU $/hour box.
